name: Python booking app
summary: Fern Studio, a class-booking app on FastAPI: browse the timetable, pay with Stripe Checkout, get a confirmation through Resend, see your bookings. Postgres through psycopg, pages rendered with Jinja2.
runsOn: A FastAPI app started with uv, in Chromium, with Postgres in Docker
shows: An app outside Node behind danwo's proxy: the official Stripe and Resend Python SDKs reach the emulators through the proxy and CA variables danwo sets, with no test hooks
Invariants that read Postgres against Stripe and Resend: one booking per paid session, one confirmation per booking, amounts equal to what Stripe charged
`danwo matrix` faulting Stripe, Resend, the webhooks and Postgres itself (52 trials), and the app surviving every one
A `STUDIO_BUG` switch that turns one safeguard off, so you can watch the matrix catch it
